# Check First

Generated by `skills/process/conflicts.py --check-first` — **never hand-edit
it**; the whole file is rewritten on every run. Fix the underlying thing (settle
the conflict, raise the confidence, re-sync the artifact) and run it again.

One list, three kinds of doubt: open conflicts, `hypothesis` / `guess`
assertions something rests on — one with no dependents yet is left out, since
nothing breaks while it stays unsettled — and artifacts whose `graphSyncedAt`
predates an assertion they cite. Ranked by dependents first, then conflicts before soft
claims before stale artifacts, then blocking before sideline, then the more
abstract layer. `↓` counts dependents at a more concrete layer, `↑` at a more
abstract one; a bare count means the vault has no layer config.
